# lazy-layers-cache 0.5.3

> Released Node.js L1/L2 cache with managed Redis setup, bounded loader work, and event-bus invalidation.

## Start

- [Introduction](https://lazy-layers-cache.vercel.app/docs): Choose the path for your task.
- [Quickstart](https://lazy-layers-cache.vercel.app/docs/quickstart): Run a cache, add Redis, read, and invalidate.
- [Production setup](https://lazy-layers-cache.vercel.app/docs/setups/production): Deployment, memory, and Redis migration.
- [Walkthrough](https://lazy-layers-cache.vercel.app/docs/walkthrough): Follow one key through the system.

- [API](https://lazy-layers-cache.vercel.app/docs/reference/api): Methods and exports.

- [Transaction coordination](https://lazy-layers-cache.vercel.app/docs/reference/transactions): Separate primary-only operation API.
- [Environment variables](https://lazy-layers-cache.vercel.app/docs/reference/environment-variables): Setup and runtime controls.
